lessons_used: sign_in, copy changes remain consistently helpful, winning 5 out of 7 tests (+2.8% average after noise correction).
adoption, redesign changes are helpful, winning 3 out of 5 tests (+3.1% average after noise correction), while 2 showed no clear effect.

home, new_flow, finish, redesign, choose_path, copy, sign_in, hint, finish, hint, home, notification, and adoption, layout changes consistently showed no clear effect or performed worse across multiple tests.

candidates.title: Persistent Pet Account Sync Copy
candidates.change: Display explicit copy reassuring users that signing in safely saves their pet progress, state, and custom desktop pets permanently.
candidates.why: Support mail received 8 complaints about pets missing or reset after signing in; sign_in copy changes have a strong winning track record (+2.8% average gain).

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Pet & Progress Permanently
sign_in.body: Sign in to ensure your desktop pet, customized items, and memory state are safely saved to your account and recoverable anytime.

guard.reason: Valid copy update for the sign-in screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Proven track record (+2.8%) directly addressing high support volume (8 complaints) with zero dev overhead.
